title: The Clever Fox
text:
Long ago, a fox lived in a small forest. The fox was very clever. Every day, he walked to the river to drink water. One day, he saw a big bird near the river.

The bird was sad. Its wing was hurt. The fox said, 'I can help you.' He took the bird home and made a warm bed for it. After a week, the bird could fly again.

options: In a house near the sea

questions.text: What was wrong with the bird?
options: It could not find its nest

questions.text: Why did the fox help the bird?
options: He wanted to eat the bird
He wanted to sell the bird
He was angry with the bird

questions.text: What is the main lesson of this story?
options: Helping others is a good thing to do
Foxes should never go near rivers

vocabulary.definition: a large area with many trees
a large amount of water that flows across the land
the part of a bird's body that it uses to fly

paragraph_translations: Hace mucho tiempo, un zorro vivía en un pequeño bosque. El zorro era muy listo. Todos los días, caminaba hasta el río para beber agua. Un día, vio un pájaro grande cerca del río.
El pájaro estaba triste. Su ala estaba herida. El zorro dijo: «Yo puedo ayudarte». Llevó al pájaro a su casa e hizo una cama cálida para él. Después de una semana, el pájaro podía volar otra vez.
